notes.title: Base Raid 1.0.0 - Steam Workshop, Grenade Launchers and much more!
notes.content:
[h1]Base Raid 1.0.0 is now available.[/h1]

After years of working on Base Raid we have finally reached a state for the game that we can call it "finished" in a way. We will although of course still fix any issues and might work on new features but we will move our main focus to future games. So, thank you, everyone, for helping us get here and we hope you will enjoy our work.

- The Base Raid dev team


[b]Steam Workshop[/b]

Base Raid now has Steam Workshop support which lets you share your own creations to the Steam Community with a single push of a button straight from inside of Base Raid. We may also add in some of the workshop stages into the game if we find great stages.

To learn more about posting your Workshop stages, visit this guide: [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1136934293] Workshop Guide [/url]


[b]Grenade Launchers[/b]

There's a new type of turrets; grenade launchers. These new turrets obviously shoot grenades but more interestingly they can shoot four different types of grenades which can be chosen from the base editor.

The grenade types are as follows:

Basic
These are just regular grenades, nothing fancy here.

Incendiary
These grenades create some flames when they hit something.

EMP
These grenades disable generators, turrets and shields inside of a small area.

Cluster
These grenades break into three separate grenades and then explode one by one.


[b]Generators[/b]

There are now generators which are required for all the turrets and shields to work. They also have a much more intuitive editing interface than the turrets.


[b]New Vehicles[/b]

There are also some new vehicles in the game:

Armored Jeep
This is like a regular jeep but has a tougher armor.

Flamethrower Jeep
This is slightly sturdier than a regular jeep but also has a flamethrower attached to it so it can deal some extra damage.

Jet
This is a faster plane than the bomber but can carry less bombs.


[b]New Bombs[/b]

There are new bombs that the air strikes drop:

Incendiary
This bomb creates some flames when hitting it's target.

Large Bomb
This is an extremely powerful bomb which consist of multiple explosions and flames. Definitely worth a try!


[b]Small Changes[/b]

The flames in Base Raid have been completely renewed and are hugely more dynamic than the ones before.

Some stages have been balanced.

Some major and also minor issues have been fixed.

notes.title: Base Raid Alpha 1.7.0 - Difficulties, New Achievements, New Resolutions
notes.content:
[h1]Base Raid Alpha 1.7.0 is now available.[/h1]


[b]Difficulties[/b]

There are now 4 difficulties: Builder, Easy, Normal and Hard.

Builder: Normal difficulty but with unlimited resources for building your base.

Easy: 150% of the resources from completing levels than with normal difficulty, AI is not as smart and a better starting base.

Normal: Original difficulty of Base Raid.

Hard: 75% of the resources from completing levels than with normal difficulty, AI is smarter and a worse starting base.


[b]New Achievements[/b]

There are new achievements for completing the desert map in different difficulties.


[b]New Resolutions[/b]

We added support for two new resolutions: 1920 x 1200 and 2560 x 1440.


[b]Tweaks[/b]

Replaying a stage now gives you 25% of the resources you got the first time completing the stage.


[b]Coming up[/b]

We're also working on lots of new things including new stages, blocks, weapons and vehicles so stay tuned!

notes.title: Base Raid Alpha 1.5.0 - Music, Difficulty
notes.content:
[h1]Base Raid Alpha 1.5.0 is now available.[/h1]


[b]Music[/b]

Base Raid's soundtrack has been completely remade with the help of Australian Institute of Music. The soundtrack is available here and all the proceeds to $200 will be donated to The Australian Childrens' Music Foundation: [url=https://ausinstituteofmusicgameensembles.bandcamp.com/album/base-raid]Base Raid OST on Bandcamp[/url]


[b]Difficulty[/b]

The level of difficulty of your and the enemy's base will be shown before a battle with details about turrets and mines.


[b]Tweaks[/b]

Many tweaks have been made including smoke from plane turbines, turbulence added to the plane and optimisation.


[b]Coming up[/b]

We're also working on lots of new things including new stages and vehicles so stay tuned!

[b]Bug fixes![/b]

notes.title: Base Raid Alpha 1.2.0 - New game mode, christmas update, language support!
notes.content:
[h1]Base Raid Alpha 1.2.0 is now available to everyone.[/h1]

It's the biggest update yet since Base Raid's Early Access launch on Steam with lots of new things to take a look at.


[b]New game mode - Mirror[/b]

In the new game mode called "Mirror" the enemy surrounds your base and you use the same base you can build in the base editor but it has been mirrored in the middle of the battlefield.

When you move your turrets on one side, the turrets on the other side will mirror the movement and you'll have to stay aware of the enemy on both sides.


[b]Christmas update[/b]

We've added some christmas themed stuff into the game. Go check it out yourself, we don't want to spoil it.


[b]Language support[/b]

The game is now available in Finnish language and we are working on support for more languages to be added soon. 

To change your language, in your Steam library go to Base Raid's properties and choose your preferred language from the dropdown in the "Language" tab.


[b]Bug fixes![/b]

Base Raid is an Early Access game, which means it is normal to find bugs every now and then. We just fixed dozens of them and to make sure everyone gets the best gameplay experience we keep fixing the issues we encounter.


[b]Merry christmas and happy new year![/b]
